terms.gloss: loud, clear (of a voice or sound)
terms.comment: Of sound, clear and loud at once: vōx clāra, clāmor clārus (Plaut.). In speaking loudly is clārā vōce or magnā vōce, or the adverb clārē; louder, clārius. The word’s other senses are bright and famous.
Magnus of a voice is loud (see big).

evidence: Plin. Ep. 9.36.3: clārē et intentē … legō

phrases.latin: asellus nōtum proximum tēctum subit et vōce magnā sēsē vēnisse indicat
phrases.english: the donkey goes into the nearest house he knows and announces in a loud voice that he has come

phrases.latin: et exclāmāvērunt vōce magnā: «ipse fēcit nōs»
phrases.english: and they cried out in a loud voice, “He made us”

sources: Lewis & Short: clarus · Lewis & Short: magnus
